pages.text: The Large Potion Canister is an expanded JDT potion canister with $(bold)4,000 mB$() of storage.$(br2)$(bold)Batch filling rules$()$(br2)$(li)Each fill requires $(bold)4 matching potions$().$(li)A successful batch adds $(bold)1,000 mB$().$(li)Three potions or mixed potion contents do not consume the input.$(br2)$(bold)Crafting$()
